title.en: AI Success Rate on Online Freelance Work Surges from 2.5% to 16.1% in 8 Months — CAIS Remote Labor Index
title.zhHans: AI 在线自由职业任务成功率 8 个月内从 2.5% 飙升至 16.1%——CAIS 远程劳动指数

searchSummary.en: The Remote Labor Index shows AI systems jumping from 2.5% to 16.1% success on economically valuable online tasks in under 8 months. Fable 5 leads at 16.1%, Opus 4.8 at 8.3%.
searchSummary.zhHans: 远程劳动指数显示 AI 系统在经济价值在线任务上的成功率在不到 8 个月内从 2.5% 跃升至 16.1%。Fable 5 以 16.1%领先，Opus 4.8 为 8.3%。

summary.en: On July 6, 2026, the Center for AI Safety (CAIS) and Scale Labs published an update to the Remote Labor Index (RLI), showing that AI systems' success rate on economically valuable online freelance projects surged from 2.5% (October 2025) to 16.1% (July 2026) — more than a sixfold increase in under eight months. Frontier models tested: Fable 5 (16.1%), Claude Opus 4.8 (8.3%), GPT-5.5 (6.3%). The RLI tests AI systems on fully end-to-end online projects across domains including 3D/CAD, architecture, graphic design, video/animation, audio, data analysis, and web applications. The accelerating capability has sparked renewed debate about AI's impact on employment and whether humans can innovate their comparative advantages fast enough to stay ahead.
summary.zhHans: 2026年7月6日，AI 安全中心（CAIS）和 Scale Labs 发布了远程劳动指数（RLI）的更新，显示 AI 系统在经济价值在线自由职业项目上的成功率从 2.5%（2025年10月）飙升至 16.1%（2026年7月）——在不到八个月内增长超过六倍。受测前沿模型：Fable 5（16.1%）、Claude Opus 4.8（8.3%）、GPT-5.5（6.3%）。RLI 测试 AI 系统在包括 3D/CAD、建筑、平面设计、视频/动画、音频、数据分析和网页应用等领域的全端到端在线项目。能力的加速引发了关于 AI 对就业影响以及人类是否能创新自身比较优势以保持领先的新一轮辩论。

narrative.en: The Remote Labor Index, developed by CAIS in collaboration with Scale Labs, measures how well AI systems can complete economically valuable online freelance projects in a fully end-to-end way. Each project involves complex multistep workflows — for example, redesigning an engagement ring from a client brief, producing a 60-second animated advertisement with voiceover, or creating dimensioned floor plans from scanned site measurements. At launch in October 2025, AI systems succeeded on only 2.5% of these tasks. By July 2026, that figure had surged to 16.1% — the frontier had 'more than quadrupled in under eight months.' Fable 5 led with 16.1%, nearly double Claude Opus 4.8 at 8.3% and more than 2.5x GPT-5.5 at 6.3%. The research raises fundamental questions about the trajectory of AI-driven labor automation. CAIS researcher comments in Import AI framed the issue starkly: 'What happens to online employment when this reaches 80%? Is the speed at which humans innovate and render themselves newly competitive relative to AI systems going to be faster than both the raw capability expansion of AI and the increasing fluency with which they can use all the same tools their human competitors use?' The RLI joins a growing set of benchmarks tracking AI's real-world economic capability, providing concrete data points for what has largely been a theoretical debate about AI and employment.
narrative.zhHans: 远程劳动指数由 CAIS 与 Scale Labs 合作开发，衡量 AI 系统在完全端到端的方式下完成经济价值在线自由职业项目的能力。每个项目涉及复杂的多步骤工作流程——例如，根据客户简报重新设计订婚戒指、制作带配音的 60 秒动画广告、或根据扫描的现场测量数据创建标注尺寸的平面图。在 2025 年 10 月推出时，AI 系统仅能完成 2.5% 的这些任务。到 2026 年 7 月，这一数字已飙升至 16.1%——前沿能力'在不到八个月内增长了四倍多'。Fable 5 以 16.1% 领先，接近 Claude Opus 4.8（8.3%）的两倍，是 GPT-5.5（6.3%）的 2.5 倍以上。该研究提出了关于 AI 驱动的劳动力自动化轨迹的根本性问题。CAIS 研究者在 Import AI 中的评论直截了当地提出了这个问题：'当这个比率达到 80% 时，在线就业会发生什么？人类创新并使其自身相对于 AI 系统重新具有竞争力的速度，能否同时快于 AI 原始能力的扩展速度和它们使用人类竞争对手所用工具的熟练度提升速度？'RLI 加入了一组越来越多的跟踪 AI 实际经济能力的基准，为一直主要是理论性的 AI 与就业辩论提供了具体的数据点。

description.en: RLI trajectory (2.5% → 16.1% in 8 months) suggests economically significant labor automation is accelerating. If trend continues, significant impact on online freelance market and broader knowledge work within 1-3 years.
description.zhHans: RLI 轨迹（8 个月内 2.5% → 16.1%）表明经济显著的自劳动力自动化正在加速。如果趋势持续，1-3 年内将对在线自由职业市场和更广泛的知识工作产生重大影响。

description.en: Provides the first concrete, repeatable measurement of AI's growing economic capability. Shifts the AI-and-employment debate from theoretical speculation to data-driven assessment.
description.zhHans: 提供了首个可重复的、对 AI 不断增长的经济能力的具体测量。将 AI 与就业的辩论从理论推测转向数据驱动的评估。

description.en: Demonstrates that AI systems can now complete complex, multi-step, domain-specific freelance projects end-to-end. The capability extends well beyond text generation to encompass specialized professional work.
description.zhHans: 展示了 AI 系统现在可以端到端完成复杂的、多步骤的、特定领域的自由职业项目。该能力远远超出文本生成，涵盖了专业化的专业工作。

text.en: AI systems' success rate on the Remote Labor Index rose from 2.5% (October 2025) to 16.1% (July 2026), according to CAIS and Scale Labs.
text.zhHans: 据 CAIS 和 Scale Labs 数据，AI 系统在远程劳动指数上的成功率从 2.5%（2025年10月）升至 16.1%（2026年7月）。

text.en: Fable 5 achieved 16.1%, Claude Opus 4.8 achieved 8.3%, and GPT-5.5 achieved 6.3% on the RLI benchmark.
text.zhHans: Fable 5 在 RLI 基准上达到 16.1%，Claude Opus 4.8 达到 8.3%，GPT-5.5 达到 6.3%。

text.en: The frontier has more than quadrupled in under eight months, representing a concrete signal of rapidly advancing economically capable AI agents.
text.zhHans: 前沿能力在不到八个月内增长了四倍多，代表着经济能力不断增强的 AI 智能体快速进步的具体信号。

text.en: Critics argue that 16.1% remains low and many tasks require specialized human judgment that AI systems may not achieve for years, if ever. The test also does not account for new task creation that often accompanies automation.
text.zhHans: 批评者认为 16.1% 仍然很低，许多任务需要人类专业判断，AI 系统可能多年甚至永远无法达到。该测试也未考虑通常伴随自动化而来的新任务创造。

sources.quote: Remote Labor Index update: 2.5% to 16.1%, frontier more than quadrupled in under eight months.
A significant increase in digital labor automation detected.
